1.name: Favored Enemy
1.description: You always have the Hunter's Mark spell prepared. You can cast it twice without expending a spell slot, and you regain all expended uses of this ability when you finish a Long Rest.

1.name: Weapon Mastery
1.description: Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change the kinds of weapons you chose.

1.name: Spellcasting
1.description: You have learned to channel the magical essence of nature to cast spells. You prepare spells from the Ranger spell list, using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability. You can use a Druidic Focus as a spellcasting focus for your Ranger spells.

2.name: Deft Explorer
2.description: You are an unsurpassed explorer and survivor. You gain Expertise in one of your skill proficiencies of your choice. You also know two additional languages of your choice.

2.name: Fighting Style
2.description:
You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice. Instead of choosing one of those feats, you can choose the Druidic Warrior option below.
 - **Druidic Warrior**: You learn two Druid cantrips of your choice (Guidance and Starry Wisp are recommended). Whenever you gain a Ranger level, you can replace one of these cantrips with another Druid cantrip. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for them.
Whenever you gain a Ranger level, you can replace the feat you chose with a different Fighting Style feat.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Choose between increasing your ability scores or selecting a feat.

5.name: Extra Attack
5.description: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on you r turn.

6.name: Roving
6.description: Your Speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing Heavy armor. You also have a Climb Speed and a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
8.description: Choose between increasing your ability scores or selecting a feat.

9.name: Expertise
9.description: You gain Expertise in two of your skill proficiencies of your choice.

10.name: Tireless
10.description:
Primal forces now help fuel you on your journeys, granting you the following benefits:
 - **Temporary Hit Poinfs**: As a Magic action, you can give yourself a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to ld8 plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1). You can use this action a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
 - **Decrease Exhaustion**: Whenever you finish a Short Rest, your Exhaustion level, if any, decreases by 1.

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
12.description: Choose between increasing your ability scores or selecting a feat.

13.name: Relentless Hunter
13.description: Taking damage can't break your Concentration on Hunter's Mark.

14.name: Nature's Veil
14.description:
You invoke spirits of nature to magically hide yourself. As a Bonus Action, you can give yourself the Invisible condition until the end of your next turn.
	You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
16.description: Choose between increasing your ability scores or selecting a feat.

17.name: Precise Hunter
17.description: You have Advantage on attack rolls against the creature currently marked by your Hunter's Mark.

18.name: Feral Senses
18.description: Your connection to the forces of nature grants you Blindsight with a range of 30 feet.

19.name: Epic Boon Feat
19.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat (see chapter 5) or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Boon of Fate is recommended.

20.name: Foe Slayer
20.description: The damage die of your Hunter's Mark becomes a d10 instead of a d6.
